method: read-only raw JSONL structured fact-table census, one Korean representative per translated graph
majority_rule: key=(family,subject,queried_role), modal TRAIN entity ID, ties choose lowest entity ID; ignore TEST context
limitation: graph split is not entity/question/edge-disjoint; supports within-generator recombination/lookup diagnosis, not unseen world knowledge or new entity/role generalization
interval_scope: future graph-resampling intervals remain descriptive for fixed fixture/model; no calibrated architecture/global intelligence claim
